name: release-script-header-formula-count
body: scripts/release.sh's header comment at line 6 still reads "Repoints the 7 Homebrew formulae" while the `for f in Formula/*.rb` loop covers eight formulae (scanner plus the seven per-language formulae). The staleness pre-dates the macos-15 change-set and was deliberately left outside task 2's diff-freeze, which confined that task to the formula-revision commit message. Limit: a reader of the script's header is told there are seven formulae. Upgrade: fold the one-word correction (7 to 8) into the next scripts/** cleanup task, or into any change that reopens scripts/release.sh.
